test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 6 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

l. All phones are laptops.

ll. All pen-drives are phones.

III. All pen-drives are pens.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are phones.

II. All laptops are pens.

III. All pen-drives are laptops.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given below according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c3221fceb9a002113008b8b37007a885d75c07dace8b73fc368d116cb004245.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I. All pens are phones → **Does not follow **→ (As all pen-drive are phones and all pen-drives are pens. So it is possible but not definitely true)

II. All laptops are pens → **Does not follow **→ (As all phones are laptop and all pen-drives are pens. So it is possible but not definitely true)

III. All pen-drives are laptops → **Follow **→ (As all phones are laptop and all pen-drive are phones. So as all pen-drives comes in phones which whole comes in laptops therefore it is definitely true)

**Here, Only conclusion III follows**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option - (1)".**
